title: I love this app but….
body: I really like this app,  but I believe that the option of being able to repeat tasks for several days should not be paid for as it is a basic option. It takes away a lot of productivity for those who want to build habits because these people will have to create multiple tasks and schedule multiple times all over again, everyday. In other productivity apps this doesn't happen since this app is the only one I know where this option is paid, I'm quite sad because I really liked the concept and the entire aesthetic.

title: Best planner for the neurodivergent
body:
This app is an amazing helper for people who struggle with time management and need a visual map of their tasks, and it has made a huge difference in my life by giving me more structure. I'd suggest adding, at least, a weekly and monthly views of the calendar, so it's easier to reschedule tasks with drag&drop.
It's definitly one of the best apps I've used for time management and routine tracking.

title: Apenas uma bboa ideia
body: Como em muitas coisas na vida, nós precisamos de conhecer a árvore e também ter uma visão da floresta. Com o Structured nós conseguimos planear muito bem o nosso dia, está feito para conhecer bem a árvore. Mas se temos o azar de ter que procurar rapidamente onde temos um período horário disponível nos próximos dias para marcar uma reunião, as coisas complicam-se: o Structured não só não faz como não diexa fazer. O que agendamos com o Structured, não aparece no Calender ou outras agenda. Temos que andar À procura dia a dia no Structured...

title: Fantastic!
body:
I’m loving the app. The way I can have all tasks I have to do together in one place. And it’s so easy to use. I have one suggestion: develop an app for Apple Watch. Then I could say the app was perfect.
Another suggestion is the ability to search past and/or future events. Sometimes I need to see when was my last appointment of some kind or when it will be. Now, I have to look day by day. With a search option, it would be very easy to find.
